## Problem and change / 问题与修改

What problem does this solve, and what will users experience?
解决了什么问题，用户会看到怎样的行为？

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually run and their outcomes. Add screenshots for UI changes.
列出实际执行的检查与结果；界面修改请附截图。

## Data and compatibility / 数据与兼容性

If relevant, explain changes to exports, timestamps, saved sessions or audio identities. Note new third-party material and its license.
如有影响，请说明导出、时间戳、已保存标注或音频身份的变化，以及新增第三方素材的许可。
